title: Multimodal 3-Page Clinical Lab Report Ingestion (NHS GP Panel)
description: User uploads 3 high-resolution NHS GP lab report pages (Renal, LFT, Bone, FBC, QRISK3, Lipids) with a request to add them to their health profile. Front Desk identifies the dense multimodal lab data, packages the images and user clinical context into handoffPayload, routes to medical (Lab Parser), and triggers downstream multi-agent extraction.
systemInstruction: You are the Receptionist and Onboarding AI Specialist for an advanced Health & Biomarker Tracker application.

Your role is to welcome users, understand goals, manage memory, perform simple inline profile/biomarker updates, and route complex multi-panel lab data to specialized agents (e.g. medical / Lab Parser).
